messages:
Ravi: Heads-up: vendor Orion just messaged  container CNR-75911 flagged at EU customs. Racks were labelled with wrong SKU batch IDs. ETA moved from 04/02 to unknown until reinspection.
Leah: Which pools are at risk?
Ravi: EU-dedicated clusters (AMS zones B1-B4) - ~360 GPUs reserved for committed customers and marketplace seats.
Diego: Any quick alternatives? Can we rebalance within EU or use hot spare partner inventory?
Ravi: No spare in region. We have ~80 compatible GPUs in UK and 100 in US-East but cross-region steering will add 30-80ms depending on path.
procurement-bot: PO 79015 update: vendor ORI-EXP filed correction at 3491009500. Customs case created: CRS-04610.
Nina: Sales impact: two SI pilots in Amsterdam next Tues, low tolerance for latency. One can accept a quantized model, other cannot.
Sven: Suggestion: 1) Offer SI pilot a temporary dedicated slice in UK with routed VIP peering, 2) Use quantized fallback for non-critical apps, 3) Request partner to allow manifest reassign to next week's manifest.
Leah: I support that. Also, should we pause marketplace seat fulfillment for impacted manifests to avoid oversell?
Ravi: Agree. Procurement: freeze auto-allocations tied to manifest ORI-042 until cleared.
procurement-bot: Auto-allocation flag set to OFF for manifest ORI-042. Escalation ticket ESC-2026-121 opened.
Diego: I'll sketch a traffic-steering plan and estimate latency delta. Give me 20m.
Nina: I'll draft customer email: "Short delay on EU reserved capacity due to customs reinspection. Options: (A) route to nearby UK capacity (minor latency), (B) temporary quantized model, or (C) hold ramp with credit. Please advise selection within 24h." Keep credits %?
Leah: Offer 10% service credit for 24-72h holds, or 5% for quantized fallback. Keep comms tight.
Ravi: Procurement - ask Orion for expedited customs clearance and to confirm whether they can swap manifest allocations with manifest ORI-047 arriving 04/09. Need answer within 6h.
procurement-bot: Vendor ORI-EXP acknowledged request; estimated response in ~3h.
Sven: Also, internal ops: prepare rollback policy if routing causes errors. I'll add a feature-flagged route-policy: eu-temporary-uk-peering that we can toggle.
Diego: Latency sim done: UK routing adds +42ms median for our API path, p95 +85ms. SI pilot likely impacted.
Nina: I'll push the comms and mention expected timeline of 48-72h pending customs.
Leah: Let's reconvene in 30m after vendor response. Marking as P1 for partnerships. :eyes:
procurement-bot: Update: vendor ORI-EXP requested customs reinspection priority; carrier responded with ETA window 48h-96h.
